candidate: E22b drafter W8A16, context K/V BF16
decision: The owner accepted E22b and asked to promote it as the new baseline, integrating IaC, documentation and README; no separate reproduction run.
limits: Three complete suites on one retained E22b load, compared with the three-suite E21 reference measured earlier the same day; dispersion, not statistical significance.

C4 was 90.213 tok/s in run 1, below the E21 range, and 101.571 and 95.901 tok/s in runs 2 and 3; per-stream TTFT at C2 and C4 was high in run 1 only. Concurrent first-token times are quantized in engine-step units in every variant.

C2 per-stream TTFT median is 4.8% above E21, driven by run 1; 64K cold prefill median is 1.4% below E21 and 3 tok/s under its minimum. Both are treated as noise-level differences, recorded as observed.
8K cold prefill median is 1.3% below E21 and inside the E21 range; in the matched 10-request probe it was 0.4% below E21, compared with 3.0% for E22.
Drafter acceptance (accepted/drafted, rank-0 engine intervals) is 0.621/0.611/0.611, compared with 0.634/0.638/0.616 for E21 and 0.591/0.583/0.608 for E22.
Target verification should keep generated tokens those of the target at temperature 0; the verifier code was not reviewed, so this is an expectation and acceptance is measured.
Promotion by owner decision without a separate reproduction run: the encoded default produces a launcher command identical, on all four ranks, to the measured E22b load.
